title: Focus
description: A justified lyric block where every line sits at its own distance from the lens, with Rubber Soul, Abbey Road and Let It Be set inline between the words beside a small moon and star. Focus racks slowly down the lines on its own; turn the ribbed focus ring or tap a line to take over, and the covers blur and sharpen with their line.
intent: Depth of field as typography: each line, with its inline album cover and glyph atoms sized in em on the baseline, is a layer at a set distance, blurred by a disc kernel from the diopter gap to the focus ring, so sharpness alone shows where the lens is.
sources: herb reference board: ee6eda60 and 0fc59ca9 justified, softened lyric blocks
